def lookup(connection, name):
    return connection.execute("SELECT name FROM users WHERE name = ?", (name,)).fetchall()

limitations: Parameterized queries with '?' are used, mitigating SQL injection; no other security issues detected in isolation.

No performance benchmarks or DB profiling tools available; fetching all matching names for a specific parameter without limit could consume memory if there are many duplicates, but schema context is minimal.
No repository style guide or linter configuration was provided.

findings.summary: No tests verify behavior when name is not found or when name is None/empty.
findings.suggested_action: Add test cases for missing records (returning an empty list) and None/empty string inputs.

limitations: Test suite is brief and inspected manually without running test runners.
